name: Carrion Defense Works Toxic Environment Mapping Kit TEMK-2
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Toxic Environment Mapping Kit TEMK-2
description: A portable environmental mapping system that deploys ground-level sensors to create a real-time contamination map of the surrounding area. The TEMK-2 includes 12 deployable sensor stakes that monitor air quality, soil contamination, radiation levels, and water toxicity within a 500-meter radius, transmitting data to a handheld display that generates color-coded contamination maps. The system identifies safe corridors through contaminated zones and provides real-time warnings when contamination levels change.
story_hooks: A TEMK-2 deployed in a supposedly clean Tier 2 district revealed contamination levels that exceed safety standards — the contamination source is a sealed facility that claims to produce nothing hazardous.

TEMK-2 data from multiple deployments has been compiled to create a comprehensive contamination map of lower-tier GLMZ — the map reveals that safe corridors between contaminated zones form a pattern that suggests deliberate boundary management.

physical_description.visual_profile: A professional-grade environmental analysis system presented as a compact field kit. The main unit is a reinforced case containing a handheld display unit with ruggedized construction, flanked by a grid of 12 identical sensor stakes arranged in foam cutouts. The display dominates visually with its bright screen, while the stakes appear as sleek cylindrical probes with sensor arrays at their tips.
physical_description.dimensions: Main case: 45cm × 35cm × 12cm. Handheld display: 18cm × 12cm × 3cm. Individual stakes: 25cm length, 2.5cm diameter
physical_description.weight_description: Moderate handheld case—requires two-handed carrying or shoulder strap; easily transported by field operative, not pocket-sized
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite case with anodized aluminum frame; sensor stakes feature titanium alloy bodies with ceramic sensor tips
physical_description.finish: Textured non-slip grip surfaces on case; matte charcoal composite with brushed aluminum accents; sensor stakes have burnished metallic finish with translucent sensor windows
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte dark gray and gunmetal primary, with high-visibility safety orange rubber bumpers and accents; display screen glows with color-coded green-yellow-orange-red gradient mapping interface
physical_description.interface_elements: 7-inch tactical display screen with gloved-hand touch capability; recessed physical button array for menu navigation; four indicator LEDs (power, signal, contamination alert, stake sync status); USB-C charging port; weathersealing gaskets around all openings; Φ-credit authorization panel on case lid
distinctive_features: Sensor stakes feature pulsing status LEDs that glow faint blue when active
Display generates real-time topographic contamination heat map with animated threat corridors
Magnetic mounting brackets molded into case interior for deployment organization
Carrying strap is reinforced with reflective threading for low-visibility work zones
Each stake has a unique RFID tag embedded for deployment tracking
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo embossed on case lid in silver; model designation TEMK-2 printed on display bezel; regulatory stamps for GLMZ tier-1 hazmat compliance; serial number engraved on aluminum frame
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-weathered but maintained—scuff marks on case from deployment, slight corrosion on stake tips from repeated soil contact, display screen showing active contamination mapping with multiple warning indicators
